# Keyboard shortcuts

Technical reference for **Settings / Interface / Keyboard shortcuts**. The app shows a short summary;
this page keeps the full detail.

## Shortcut editor (page help)

Record a qualified chord or enter one explicitly. Each Save applies only its own field. Conflicting
chords and protected editing or system chords are rejected; the value `none` disables an optional
shortcut. The Voice shortcut uses the same binding here and on the Voice dictation page.

## Open Moguri shortcut

**Open Moguri** (default Shift+Cmd+O, stored as `Primary+Shift+KeyO`) brings Moguri forward from any
app, reopening the window if it was closed. It is a system-wide shortcut registered while Moguri runs and
it also shows next to Open Moguri in the menu-bar menu. If another app already owns the chord, Moguri
says so and leaves it off; choose another chord or `none`. The active profile's value applies.

## Page intro

Shortcuts respect IME composition and text editing. Terminal input belongs to its focused console, not
the chat.
